Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 12  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "Solos en la madrugada" has the director born earlier. The task was to determine which director was born earlier, not which was older at the release of their film. The Planner misinterpreted the problem by comparing the directors' ages at their respective film releases, rather than their birth years. Eduardo Morera was born in 1906 and José Luis Garci in 1944, so Morera was born earlier.
